en:
Ahhh, a battle like this takes me back...
After all, hope and despair are natural enemies.
Yes, this is truly a magnificent theme.

Puhuhu... Only esteemed works of fiction
have themes as magnificent as this.
Anyway...where's Kokichi? Why isn't he here?

<CLT=cltMIND>Maki was right. The person who
<CLT=cltSTRONG>should be here<CLT=cltMIND>...isn't.
Well...I'll tell you once the trial starts.

Wh-What's going on? What are you 
scheming now?
It doesn't matter what Kokichi is scheming.

This is the final battle between hope and
despair! It all ends here!

Kokichi can twist and violate the rules all he
likes, but we'll never give up!
Hope...will never submit to despair!

Oh, for the love of... No rules have been
violated. Not on my watch, y'know?
Whatever... Hurry up and start.

We'll end it with this class trial. We'll defeat the
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Remnants of Despair<CLT=typeNORMAL>, no matter what.
...So, get ready.
Yeah, yeah, I got it. Now, let's get started.

Mix equal parts life and death, add a dash of
lies and truth, bake it in fires of conflict...

And when it's golden brown and bubbling, you
have yourself a truly decadent class trial!
<CLT=cltMIND>And once more, we faced a class trial.
<CLT=cltMIND>Was the one who died...Kaito or Kokichi?

<CLT=cltMIND>I can't say for certain...
but I still believe.
<CLT=cltMIND>...Kaito wouldn't die so easily.

<CLT=cltMIND>I...don't know why I believe
that so strongly...
<CLT=cltMIND>But I will fight to prove it.
<CLT=cltMIND>I will fight with everyone.

<CLT=cltMIND>To grasp the <CLT=cltSTRONG>hope<CLT=cltMIND> on
the other side of this truth...
<CLT=cltMIND>I will fight.

<CLT=cltMIND>I will fight in this
trial of truth and lies!
